description: The 'scenario_runs' dataset provides detailed information about various scenarios executed within a system, capturing essential metadata for each run. This dataset is particularly useful for analyzing the performance and outcomes of different scenarios, which can be critical for operational monitoring and optimization. Each entry in the dataset represents a single scenario run, identified by a unique 'scenario_run_id'. The dataset includes timestamps for when each scenario started and ended, allowing for precise tracking of execution times. Additionally, it records the outcome of each run, such as 'SUCCESS', and counts any warnings that occurred. The dataset also includes information about the user who initiated the run and the method used to trigger the scenario. This comprehensive dataset can be used for performance analysis, troubleshooting, and improving scenario execution strategies. It is particularly valuable for IT operations, project management, and system maintenance teams who need to ensure the reliability and efficiency of automated processes.
shortDesc: Dataset of scenario runs with timestamps and outcomes.

columns.name: scenario_project_key
columns.comment: Unique key for the scenario project, identifies project.

columns.name: scenario_id
columns.comment: Identifier for the specific scenario, unique scenario ID.

columns.name: scenario_run_id
columns.comment: Unique identifier for each scenario run, tracks execution.

columns.name: time_start
columns.comment: Timestamp when the scenario run started, start time.

columns.name: time_end
columns.comment: Timestamp when the scenario run ended, end time.

columns.name: outcome
columns.comment: Result of the scenario run, indicates success or failure.

columns.name: warnings_count
columns.comment: Number of warnings during the scenario run, warning count.

columns.name: scenario_name
columns.comment: Name of the scenario, descriptive scenario title.

columns.name: trigger_name
columns.comment: Method used to trigger the scenario, trigger type.

columns.name: scenario_run_as_user
columns.comment: User who executed the scenario, run initiator.

columns.name: run_as_user_identifier
columns.comment: Identifier for the user who ran the scenario, user ID.

columns.name: run_as_user_via
columns.comment: Method or context through which user ran scenario, execution context.
